title: Tiffin Tracker Update
message: Morphe-inspired update: Background update checks when app is closed, direct in-app download progress, and 1-tap installer!
releaseNotes: Background update alerts via Android WorkManager even when app is closed
Morphe-style luxury update dialog with version comparison & changelog
Direct in-app APK download with real-time progress bar
1-Tap seamless package installer launch without browser redirects
